facts.fact: The South African Reserve Bank Financial Surveillance Department issued for consultation a draft exchange control circular letting payment aggregators partner Authorised Dealers to process cross-border retail e-commerce payments by residents, up to R50 000 per transaction, after two regulatory sandbox use cases.

ZAF.note: An exchange control draft on payment aggregators is not an e-commerce transactions law.
